trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute angle, approximately 45 degrees, forming a sharp V-shaped convergence at the fluke's center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, jagged serrations with 3-4 distinct peaks; the right lobe trailing edge is comparatively smoother, terminating in a secondary notch at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the upper span of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the lateral extremities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive irregular indentation on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe and a double-pointed or notched morphology at the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the lower fluke surface by high-velocity water droplets and splash.
